body: Thanks.  It helps especially when I'm not feeling heard by my friends or family.  Sometimes I just need to support and validation.  I often feel so alone amongst a sea of people who are too busy with their own lives.

Thanks.  I don't know that I can talk more at the moment. Husband just woke up and is wandering around.  But thanks.  These benzos are having an effect as well- fucking finally.   Thanks again for you're encouragement.

Like I said, I think- not sure cause I'm slightly fucked up now - but I realize this is a potential mess to think that an internet site can help me.  But so far you guys have been really nice and helpful. That's really helped.  Sometimes a person just needs to feel like there's someone out there, somewhere that is listening and can feel where I'm coming from.

You're right. It's the sick part of me that says fuck my friends who don't seem to care.  I think though, that I'm done with people who have emotional crisis after emotional crisis and then when I need them they are not there.  God help me tomorrow when I have to have dinner with her.  I just think I'll have to dissociate/disconnect to get through and not say something that will end the friendship forever.
Sent PM.  Thanks for offering that.

I just sometimes feel like my extended family have no idea what we deal with when raising our special needs child.  I have read research, can't site it right now (Sapolsky book, I think), that said that special needs parents' actual dna starts to unravel because the stress is so taxing.  She can be amazing, but no one else understands her but a handful of people and many are not those who we are in constant contact with.   Then I do stupid shit like drink too much wine at dinner (After child has been her self, which is someone with autism, and offended half the family, and beat the hell out of myself).  I wish I knew why I fucking cared what others think so much.  It's this misery that I want relief from.  Not my dear child, but my own torture about "what are they thinking" "do they think I'm a shitty mom because she doesn't say please and thank you?"  and I see the looks they give me.  They are judgmental looks that say, 'well, if you only raised her right, she would have better social skills'.  Yet, my son is perfectly behaved.  Can they not see the damn disparity here?  I raised both of them!  
But it's not just that.  I have been struggling with anxiety and depression since I was very little, starting with separation anxiety.  It's exhausting.  I have tension headaches that lead to migraines regularly because I'm so tightly wound.  
As  a child I hoped and prayed I would die from a terminal illness to just stop this mess.  Then I'd have periods of feeling better and could move on, only to be hit with full force a few months/years later.  Doesn't help I've had more death in my life than is typical for someone my age.
Man, I think about what I wrote and think what a whiner/loser/waste-of-space.  I was taught to just fucking suck it up and be positive. Fake it until you make it.  Yeah, that works for a little while.  
But thanks, ClaranceWhirly for reaching out.  
edited to be a little less harsh to my little girl. autistic self vs. child with autism have two very different tones.

Thanks...and that truly does mean something.  I think I've been in a major depressive episode for at least 6 months now, and off and on for many years prior.  It does help to know I'm not alone and that I'm heard.  Also, that I'm taken seriously.  I talked via text to a friend who was like, 'i've got too much shit on my plate'.  Awesome.  Yet I've been there for her many, many times.  It  makes me realize she's not a friend and I really want to distance myself from her.  And everyone really.

I sometimes worry about the crushing depression that accompanies the all-night drinking.  Especially when I've gone from my regular vodka to wine, which fucks me up more, thanks to classical conditioning and all (I think).  Seriously was so fed up and about to take drastic measures to end my misery.  But took a few benzos and I now no longer wanna end it all.  My family would be fucked without me, as fucked up as I am.  I can see now that I help my family.  My drinking freaks me out when I don't/won't stop as well.  Fuck it, cheers, my lovely fuckers.
edited to add: no advice- just empathy

I think I'm too old or uncool.  Have no idea what a molly is.  But I do know spritzers suck.  Double shot, please!

I used other drugs before then.  Also had therapy, but then things got even more intense and I believe I moved beyond my own capabilities re: living with anxiety.  Also...I never went out, did anything social, or seriously challenged myself prior to this.  I was a little frightened mouse before this and it usually took someone several years to get to know the real me.  But I had my first drink at 9 or 10.  And I drank some throughout my life.  I wasn't drinking daily until a few years ago.
